text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There's an enemy I just can't get along 
with, someone I'll never see eye-to-eye 
with. And that is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That weird squishy texture when it goes in 
your mouth!! And that overpowering, 
pungent smell!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"An indispensable part of cooking"... I 
get what Bono's saying—but still...! What 
I hate, I hate~~~~!!
